document_metadata.title: 1、EXT. BISHOP LAKE - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Kale and Jeff lose a strong black bass after a fierce fight, share a moment of quiet camaraderie, then resolve to keep fishing together.

entities.name: Kale and Jeff observe the water in anxious silence while fishing
entities.description: Kale and Jeff remain quiet and focused on the water, carefully monitoring for any sign of a fish biting the lure, building tension during their fishing activity.

entities.name: Black bass attacks the fishing lure with a powerful tail splash
entities.description: A large black bass suddenly strikes the lure, creating a dramatic splash with its tail, indicating the start of a strong struggle between the fish and the anglers.

entities.name: Kale struggles to reel in the black bass
entities.description: After the fish bites, Kale begins rapidly cranking the reel, attempting to secure the fish, but faces strong resistance from the powerful bass.

entities.name: Jeff assists Kale by grabbing the rod and helping pull the fish
entities.description: Seeing that Kale is overwhelmed, Jeff moves behind him, takes hold of the rod and reel, and helps apply force to keep the fish hooked and prevent it from escaping.

entities.name: Jeff encourages Kale with a pirate accent during the fish struggle
entities.description: While helping Kale fight the fish, Jeff adopts a playful pirate persona, urging Kale to keep pulling with phrases like 'Give it all ya got, mate,' adding humor and camaraderie to the moment.

entities.name: Kale laughs and criticizes Jeff's pirate impersonation
entities.description: Amid the physical struggle with the fish, Kale laughs and teases Jeff, saying his pirate accent is bad, highlighting their close and humorous father-son relationship.

entities.name: boat
entities.description: A small watercraft where Kale and Jeff are fishing and interacting, serving as the immediate physical setting for the scene.

entities.name: Kale
entities.description: A young man fishing with Jeff, actively trying to reel in a black bass and engaging in playful banter with Jeff.
entities.summary: A young man fishes and travels with Jeff, interacts with his mother Julie, survives a crash, struggles to save Jeff on a failing guardrail, and is later revealed as a student who punched his teacher after being caught sleeping in class.

entities.name: Jeff
entities.description: An older man fishing with Kale, who assists him in reeling in the fish and playfully adopts a pirate accent to encourage him.
entities.summary: A man shares a fishing trip with Kale, later driving with him in an SUV where they celebrate together; after a crash, the man is trapped and guides Kale to escape, then clings to a guardrail in a struggle, showing calm during the crisis.

entities.name: fishing rod and reel
entities.description: The equipment used by Kale and Jeff to catch the black bass, physically handled and shared between them during the struggle with the fish.

entities.name: fishing lure
entities.description: The artificial bait that attracts the black bass, which is attacked by the fish during the fishing attempt.

entities.name: Jeff's t-shirt
entities.description: A t-shirt worn by Jeff featuring a cartoon bass with aviator goggles and missiles, labeled 'Weapons of Bass Destruction'.

entities.name: Kale's t-shirt
entities.description: A t-shirt worn by Kale depicting a bass in a stock car uniform with the word 'BASSCAR' on it.

entities.name: fishing
entities.description: The recreational activity in which Kale and Jeff are engaged, involving the use of rods, lures, and technique to catch fish.

entities.name: Black bass breaks free from the fishing lure and escapes
entities.description: The black bass suddenly snaps the fishing line, causing the lure to come loose and the fish to escape into the water.

entities.name: Kale and Jeff lose balance after the fish escapes
entities.description: When the line goes limp after the fish breaks free, Kale and Jeff jerk backward and nearly fall, losing their balance on the boat.

entities.name: Kale reels in the empty fishing line and discards the rod in frustration
entities.description: After the fish escapes, Kale winds back the unused line and throws the fishing rod aside with a mock expression of disgust.

entities.name: Jeff sits in the captain's chair and requests a Coke
entities.description: Jeff moves to the captain's chair on the boat and asks Kale for a drink, indicating a brief pause in their fishing activity.

entities.name: Kale retrieves a Coke from the cooler and throws it to Jeff
entities.description: Without hesitation, Kale goes to the cooler, takes out a Coke, and tosses it to Jeff while on the boat.

entities.name: Kale and Jeff share a moment of silent reflection after the failed catch
entities.description: After the struggle with the fish and the escape, both characters sit quietly on the boat, catching their breath and sharing a brief moment of calm.

entities.name: Jeff comments on the weather and their quality time together
entities.description: Jeff breaks the silence by remarking on the pleasant weather and the value of spending time together with Kale despite the failed catch.

entities.name: Kale grabs the fishing pole again with renewed determination
entities.description: Responding to the previous failure, Kale picks up the fishing pole again, expressing intent to continue fishing.

entities.name: Jeff commits to catching the fish immediately after Kale
entities.description: As soon as Kale decides to try again, Jeff affirms their shared goal by declaring they will catch the fish without hesitation.

entities.name: Kale and Jeff cast their fishing lines back into the water
entities.description: Both characters simultaneously throw their fishing lines back into the water, resuming their fishing activity after the fish escaped.

entities.name: bait
entities.description: The fishing lure used to attract the black bass, mentioned as being close to the boat during the struggle.

entities.name: SUV crashes and comes to rest on a guardrail at a 45-degree angle
entities.description: After a series of violent flips, the SUV lands precariously on a wooden guardrail, perched at a 45-degree downward angle, with only its right front and rear tires gripping the rail above a 500-foot ravine.

entities.name: Airbags deflate and dust settles inside the SUV
entities.description: Following the crash, the airbags inside the SUV begin to deflate and dust slowly settles, revealing the injured occupants and the immediate aftermath of the impact.

entities.name: Jeff regains consciousness and checks on Kale
entities.description: Jeff wakes up with blood streaming from his hairline, sees Kale unconscious in the passenger seat, and calls out to him to check his condition.

entities.name: Kale regains consciousness and realizes their perilous situation
entities.description: Kale opens his eyes, responds to Jeff, and then looks down to see both his injured father and the ravine beneath them, realizing the SUV is dangerously unstable.

entities.name: Jeff instructs Kale to climb out of the SUV
entities.description: Jeff tells Kale that his leg is trapped and that Kale must climb out of the vehicle to safety, asking if he is able to do so.

entities.name: Kale struggles to unbuckle his seatbelt due to shock and a locked shoulder strap
entities.description: Kale, trembling from shock, attempts to release his seatbelt but finds the shoulder strap jammed, preventing him from turning and escaping.

entities.name: Jeff releases Kale's seatbelt buckle
entities.description: Jeff reaches over shakily and presses the release on Kale's seatbelt, causing it to snap loose and allowing Kale to drop slightly while still holding onto the door.

entities.name: Guardrail beam snaps loose from foundation under SUV's weight
entities.description: As Kale is freed, a critical beam of the guardrail breaks free from its mountings, causing the SUV to rock violently as the structure begins to fail beneath them.

entities.name: SUV interior
entities.description: The inside of the SUV where Jeff and Kale are trapped after the crash.

entities.name: ravine
entities.description: The deep valley beneath the guardrail where the SUV risks plunging from.

entities.name: guardrail
entities.description: A metal barrier designed to prevent vehicles from going over the edge, which fails under the weight of the SUV.

entities.name: cliffside

entities.name: Jeff
entities.description: A man trapped in the SUV after a crash, with a leg pinned under the crumpled dashboard, who guides his son Kale through escaping the vehicle.
entities.summary: A man shares a fishing trip with Kale, later driving with him in an SUV where they celebrate together; after a crash, the man is trapped and guides Kale to escape, then clings to a guardrail in a struggle, showing calm during the crisis.

entities.name: Kale
entities.description: A young passenger in the SUV who regains consciousness after the crash and attempts to escape as the vehicle teeters on the edge of a ravine.
entities.summary: A young man fishes and travels with Jeff, interacts with his mother Julie, survives a crash, struggles to save Jeff on a failing guardrail, and is later revealed as a student who punched his teacher after being caught sleeping in class.

entities.description: A mechanical fastening device in the SUV that secures the passenger and must be released for escape; becomes jammed during the incident.

entities.description: A wooden structural component of the guardrail system supporting the SUV after the crash, which fails under the vehicle's weight.

entities.description: The deformed interior panel of the SUV's front console, which has collapsed during the crash and traps Jeff's leg.

entities.name: shattered passenger window
entities.description: The broken window on the passenger side of the SUV, providing a view to the outside and a potential exit point.

entities.name: ravine below
entities.description: The deep chasm beneath the guardrail where the SUV would fall if the structure fails, representing the immediate environmental danger.

entities.name: Jeff helps Kale climb out of the SUV through the passenger window
entities.description: Jeff reaches up, grabs Kale's legs, and pushes to assist Kale in exiting the SUV through the shattered passenger window.

entities.name: Section of guardrail rivets behind SUV pop loose
entities.description: A section of the guardrail near the rear bumper of the SUV suddenly detaches as rivets give way under stress.

entities.name: Guardrail snaps in two and begins to collapse
entities.description: The structural integrity of the guardrail fails completely, splitting into two pieces and causing the SUV to swing outward over the ravine.

entities.name: Kale hangs on for dear life as SUV swings over ravine
entities.description: After the guardrail begins to fail, Kale struggles to maintain his grip and position as the vehicle tilts dangerously over the edge.

entities.name: Another guardrail beam rips free from foundation
entities.description: An additional beam supporting the guardrail tears away from its anchor points due to the shifting weight of the SUV.

entities.name: Kale slides down SUV door and fender, feet find edge of collapsing guardrail
entities.description: As the vehicle shifts, Kale slips along the exterior surface until his feet make contact with the fractured edge of the failing guardrail.

entities.name: Kale reaches back into SUV to help Jeff escape
entities.description: With partial footing on the broken guardrail, Kale extends his hand into the SUV, urging and preparing to pull Jeff to safety.

entities.name: Jeff unbuckles himself and reaches up toward Kale
entities.description: Jeff releases his own seatbelt and reaches upward through the passenger window to grasp Kale's hand.

entities.name: Kale pulls Jeff out of SUV just as it falls away
entities.description: Kale grabs Jeff's wrist and exerts force to pull him through the window at the exact moment the SUV detaches and begins to fall.

entities.name: Jeff's weight pulls Kale down, causing his feet to slip off the guardrail
entities.description: The momentum from pulling Jeff causes Kale to lose footing, resulting in his feet slipping off the edge of the compromised guardrail.

entities.name: Kale slams chest down on guardrail, torso wraps around top, feet dangling
entities.description: After slipping, Kale impacts the top of the guardrail with his chest and instinctively wraps his body around it to prevent falling.

entities.name: SUV crashes into ravine in explosion of dust and debris
entities.description: The SUV fully detaches from the guardrail and plummets into the ravine below, creating a large cloud of dust and debris upon impact.

document_metadata.title: 103、EXT. ROOF - NIGHT - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: Giles attacks Kale, overpowers him, and slams him on the roof; they roll toward the edge, where Kale spots his stereo speaker nearby.

entities.name: Giles lifts the ladder to trip Kale
entities.description: From the ground, Giles forcefully raises the ladder while Kale is climbing, causing Kale to lose balance and fall onto the roof.

entities.name: Kale falls and hits his head on the roof
entities.description: After being tripped by Giles' action, Kale crashes onto the roof and strikes the back of his head.

entities.name: Giles climbs the ladder and approaches Kale on the roof
entities.description: Taking advantage of the moment, Giles quickly ascends the ladder and steps onto the roof, advancing toward Kale in an aggressive manner.

entities.name: Kale prepares and swings racketball racket at Giles
entities.description: Kale stands up, readies his racketball racket in a serving stance, and forcefully hits the ball toward Giles as a warning shot.

entities.name: Kale issues a verbal warning to Giles
entities.description: After missing with the racketball, Kale declares that the shot was intended as a warning, signaling intent without immediate physical confrontation.

entities.description: The physical surface of a building where the confrontation between Kale and Giles takes place.

entities.name: Robert Giles
entities.description: A character who confronts Kale on the roof, using a ladder as a defensive tool and advancing toward Kale in a threatening manner.
entities.summary: A neighbor in a black 1965 Mustang exhibits suspicious behavior, including lurking, interacting intimately with a woman, and withholding her keys, drawing Kale's attention as a possible serial killer match.

entities.name: Kale
entities.description: A character who climbs onto the roof and engages in a confrontation with Giles, using a racketball racket as a weapon.
entities.summary: A young man fishes and travels with Jeff, interacts with his mother Julie, survives a crash, struggles to save Jeff on a failing guardrail, and is later revealed as a student who punched his teacher after being caught sleeping in class.

entities.name: racketball racket
entities.description: A sports implement wielded by Kale on the roof, used in an attempt to threaten or attack Giles.

entities.name: racketball ball
entities.description: A small rubber ball removed from Kale's racketball racket and used in an attempt to strike Giles, missing its target.

entities.name: Giles rushes at Kale who attacks him with the racket
entities.description: Giles charges toward Kale, who responds by striking him repeatedly with the racketball racket.

entities.name: Giles dodges and punches Kale in the chest
entities.description: Giles avoids Kale's attack by ducking and spinning, then delivers a punch to Kale's chest.

entities.name: Kale drops the racket and doubles over
entities.description: After being punched in the chest, Kale releases the racketball racket, which slides away, and he bends forward in pain.

entities.name: Giles grabs and pulls Kale close
entities.description: Before Kale can fall, Giles seizes him, lifts him off his feet, and pulls him into close proximity, confronting him face-to-face.

entities.name: Kale headbutts Giles
entities.description: Despite being weakened, Kale uses his remaining strength to tilt his head up and strike Giles in the face with a headbutt.

entities.name: Giles stumbles and slams onto the roof with Kale
entities.description: After being headbutted, Giles loses balance, falls backward, and lands forcefully on the roof, pulling Kale with him.

entities.name: Giles and Kale roll down the roof and stop near the edge
entities.description: The momentum from the fall causes both men to roll down the sloped roof, coming to rest just before the edge.

entities.name: Kale notices his stereo speaker on the roof
entities.description: As he looks over the edge, Kale sees his stereo speaker lying a few feet away on the roof surface.

document_metadata.title: 121、INT. KALE'S BEDROOM - WEEKS LATER
document_metadata.summary: Julie impresses Ashley with her salesmanship, while Kale remains skeptical of the buyers; their intimate moment is interrupted by Ronnie, who silently films them, creating a tense, violating atmosphere.

entities.name: Julie guides young couple on property tour
entities.description: Julie, dressed in her realtor business suit, leads a young couple up Giles' driveway and into the backyard, showing them around the property and pointing out its features with professional enthusiasm.

entities.name: Julie gives secret thumbs up to Kale and Ashley
entities.description: While conducting the property tour, Julie suddenly turns and gives a quick, secretive 'thumbs up' gesture toward Kale and Ashley watching from the window, signaling them discreetly.

entities.name: Kale expresses disbelief at Julie's behavior
entities.description: After seeing Julie's secret gesture, Kale reacts with astonishment, muttering 'No way. She can't be serious,' conveying his shock at his mother's bold and inappropriate conduct during the showing.
